title: TwinLight: A Multi-Timescale Physical-Layer-Aware T-API-Compliant Optical Domain Controller Digital Twin
abstract: arXiv:2611.09359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We demonstrate TwinLight, an open-source optical-network digital twin acting as an optical domain controller. Its T-API REST and telemetry streaming interfaces expose a physical-layer engine that combines a GNPy steady-state baseline with four analytical transients.

translated_title: TwinLight：一个多时间尺度、物理层感知、符合T-API标准的光域控制器数字孪生
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.09359v1 公告类型：交叉。我们演示了TwinLight，一个作为光域控制器的开源光网络数字孪生系统。其T-API REST接口和遥测流式接口接入了一个物理层引擎，该引擎将GNPy稳态基线与四种解析瞬态模型相结合。
tldr: TwinLight是一个开源光网络数字孪生系统，可作为光域控制器，通过T-API REST和遥测流接口提供融合GNPy稳态基线与四种解析瞬态模型的物理层引擎，实现多时间尺度的物理层感知。
en_tdlr: TwinLight is an open-source optical-network digital twin acting as an optical domain controller, exposing a physical-layer engine that combines a GNPy steady-state baseline with four analytical transients via T-API REST and telemetry streaming interfaces.
